name: Cheese Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs in a bowl until they are well mixed.
Season with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and let them set for 1-2 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over one half, fold the omelette over and slide onto a plate.

name: Tomato Frittata
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper in a bowl.
Sauté diced onion in an oven-safe pan until soft.
Add sliced tomato and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the eggs, sprinkle with cheese, and cook on the stove for 2 minutes.
Transfer the pan to the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes until set.

name: Cheesy Toast
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Place cheese between two slices, buttered sides facing out.
Toast in a pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side.
Cook until the cheese has melted and the bread is golden brown.

name: Garlic Mushroom Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain, reserving a cup of the water.
Melt butter in a pan and sauté chopped onion until translucent.
Add minced garlic and sliced mushroom, cooking until golden.
Toss the cooked pasta through the mushroom mixture, adding reserved water to loosen the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Broccoli & Bell Pepper Stir-Fry
steps: Heat oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Add chopped onion and garlic, stir-frying for 1 minute.
Add broccoli florets and sliced bell pepper, stir-frying for 4-5 minutes.
Add corn kernels and cook for a further 2 minutes.
Season to taste and serve over rice.

name: Simple Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomato and cheese into rounds of similar thickness.
Thinly slice the onion.
Arrange tomato, cheese and onion slices alternately on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper before serving.

name: Mushroom & Onion Omelette
steps: Sauté sliced mushroom and onion in butter until softened, then set aside.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the eggs into a hot, buttered pan and let the edges set.
Add the mushroom and onion mixture over one half of the omelette.
Fold the omelette over and cook for another minute before serving.

name: Garlic Bread
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix softened butter with minced garlic.
Spread the garlic butter generously over slices of bread.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until golden and crisp.

name: Tropical Fruit Salad
steps: Peel and slice the banana, pineapple and orange.
Hull and halve the strawberries.
Combine all the fruit in a bowl and toss gently.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Corn & Tomato Salsa
steps: Char the corn kernels in a dry pan until lightly golden.
Finely dice the tomato and onion.
Mince the garlic and combine everything in a bowl.
Season with salt, a squeeze of lemon, and serve with tortilla chips.
